_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Ati Leensa {player_id} tiifi gaayii LinesOfAction.
Piisota kee '{side}' ti, piisota doogii '{other}' ti.
Foormaatti sochii: `[b1b3]` (koordeenoota madda gara koordeenoota galii). Sochii seera-qabeessa sirrii, ol-ka'aa, ykn viidiyaalaa saanduu piisota (kulayyuu) sirna keessa. Dandeessa ala piisota kee, garuu miti piisota doogii; galii piisii doogii qabata.  Moo'icha yeroo piisota kee hundi 8-ooluu wal-qabata.

invalid_move.identical: Bakki maddaafi bakka dhaqu wal fakkaataa.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Sochiin sirritti ykn garaagarummaan isaa madaallii ta'uu qaba.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Fageenya mi'oota safara tokko keessa jiran waliin wal qixxaachuu qaba.
invalid_move.destination_own: Bakki itti geeffamu, meeshaa waraanaa dhuunfaatiin qabamee jira.
